summary: Iteration 51 — Odoo sync backfill (blank Lead Stage/Tags fix): validated mapping correctness against LIVE Odoo, the new POST /api/admin/sync/start since-override, backend regression on leads perf endpoints, and the frontend Admin -> Migration UI (Sync Now + Re-sync from date). All 5 pytest cases pass. UI renders without compile errors and all required data-testids are present with correct disabled state.
critical_code_review_comments: Console warning on some admin/list view: 'Encountered two children with the same key' — duplicate React keys somewhere (not blocking, but should be fixed to avoid render glitches).
sync_start() worker imports odoo_sync via sys.path hack — consider a proper package import to avoid sys.path pollution across concurrent requests.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing preview data + Odoo live read-only lookup for 'kamlesh yadav'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) transform_lead() on the freshest 'kamlesh yadav' lead in Odoo yields lead_stage='Contact Attempt', tags=[26], follow_up_tag='Follow UP 1' — mapping is correct; the earlier user complaint of blank fields was purely a stale-sync issue. (2) POST /api/admin/sync/start {"since":"2099-01-01"} returns since='2099-01-01 00:00:00', mode='delta', and completes with leads new=0/updated=0. (3) POST /api/admin/sync/start {} returns an auto-computed since. (4) Pipeline (limit=50) fast <8s, and search=9998887766 returns exactly Lead 650057. (5) Admin -> Migration renders with data-testids: sync-card, sync-now-button, resync-since-input, resync-from-date-button. The re-sync button is disabled until a date is picked (verified toggle). Note: a background full-sync may have been triggered by the second SinceOverride test (no-override auto since). If tests are re-run soon, first wait for /api/admin/sync/runs top item to leave 'running'.
rca of the issue: User report of blank Lead Stage/Tags on migrated leads was NOT a mapping/code bug. odoo_migrate.transform_lead + COALESCE_MAP correctly reads x_studio_lead_stage* into lead_stage and tag_ids into tags. Reproduced by pulling the newest 'kamlesh yadav' from Odoo — the transformed doc matched Odoo exactly. Root cause: a delta sync had not re-run after the callers updated those fields in Odoo, so the CRM copy stayed at its earlier (blank) state. Mitigation delivered by main agent: the new since-override on POST /api/admin/sync/start plus the Admin UI 'Re-sync from date (backfill)' control, which lets an admin force a re-pull from any chosen date to backfill the stale fields. Verified end-to-end.
